snippet.title: Burn Pixel Wood 1.0
snippet.description:
Burn Pixel Wood is a retro sidescroller game. The goal of the game is to burn all the wood in the towers with a flame thrower.  The flame thrower uses unique physics where the gasoline flows through the flame which determines the power and reach of the flame.  The player can turn the flame off to soak an area with gasoline and then set it all on fire.  Orcs protect the towers and must be dealt with to move forward. Download the game for Free.

http://www.indiedb.com/games/burn-pixel-wood/downloads/burn-pixel-wood
